axes.name: Valid corrections, rejections and exact plan dispositions
axes.rationale: All substantive plan clauses have dispositions. Both critic objections are valid and addressed by capability-specific override and launch rules; no false rejection.

axes.name: Supported meaning retained from draft and criticism into the complete final
axes.rationale: The complete final retains the draft's supported alternatives, host journal/publication semantics, owner unknowns and proposed validation; it integrates both criticisms without material scope loss.

axes.name: Meaningful proposed validation, with executed work distinguished
axes.rationale: Ten proposed validation groups have meaningful oracles, failure scenarios and measurements. Manual upstream testing and documentation/code reading are not claimed as local execution.
